items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 19 at 2:35PM PDT until October 19 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 10 to 15 kt expected with gusts up to 25 kt.

* WHERE...Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM PDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
